plan.notes: Official University of Arkansas 2026-27 undergraduate catalog, Psychology B.A. Eight-Semester Degree Plan. Semester totals: 16/16/16/15/16/15/15/11 = 120 units (matches catalog 'Total Units in Sequence: 120'). MATH slot: MATH 11003, MATH 11103, or any higher MATH (recorded at MATH 11003). PSYC 3000-level/4000-level slots are any courses at those levels. World language at Elementary I level or higher (or World Culture) in semesters 1-2. Capstone: PSYC 40803 Advanced Research or PSYC 42803 Advanced Seminar.
